scope: Bounded ownership summary for the shared-chrome T-a1 decision; not a replacement for the lost full historical colour-consumer inventory.

owners.scope: body background and text; header brand surface; map-layer rail; analysis panel; generic form, card, border and surface roles
owners.tA1: IN SCOPE: role tokens may be introduced only while preserving current dark computed values.

owners.scope: native Evidence & limits dialog/backdrop and application focus indicators, including the native comparison-halo checkbox
browserEvidence: Spanish Evidence & limits drawer screenshot and computed dialog/backdrop styles
owners.tA1: OUT OF SCOPE per Phase A §10; reserved for T-a2.

owners.scope: register/observed/snapshot/category badge treatments and panel-facing Lens A/B labels
browserEvidence: Lens A/B panel label computed styles
snapshot badge absent under available production snapshot
owners.tA1: OUT OF SCOPE per Phase A §10; reserved for T-a3. Preserve category meaning and A/B identity.

owners.scope: basemap-dependent Lens boundaries, map markers, SVG halo glyphs and application-owned planning geometry
owners.tA1: OUT OF SCOPE; map marks remain separate from shared UI chrome.

owners.scope: zoom, attribution, tooltip and provider-control surfaces
browserEvidence: map controls appear in desktop, tablet, mobile and satellite screenshots
owners.tA1: OUT OF SCOPE per Phase A §10; reserved for T-a4.

consumerBoundary: A shared-chrome token must not automatically recolor evidence-category hues, Lens A/B identity, map symbols, basemap-aware outlines, badges, the evidence drawer/focus ring, or Leaflet-owned controls.
